reader_summary.overview: Hello everyone and welcome to investing by the books podcast by radai. I'm your host Edipolignon and with me in the studio is my friend and colleague Niklas Savos. Today we are excited to speak to Will Barnes co-founder of in practice.

key_points.text: So Niklas, which book will we speak about?

key_points.text: So today we will discuss the book in practice featuring 11 chapters with interviews from operators of successful companies such as Spotify.

key_points.text: Each interview is with an operator with a minimum of 25 years experience in their field and the book is the first volume of a series that will be published over the coming years..

key_points.text: And what do you think about the book?

thesis: The speakers discuss the book 'In Practice,' which features interviews with operators of successful companies like Spotify and Danher, and is the first volume of a series focusing on practitioners with at least 25 years of experience. The company originated from a transition away from interviewing executives of distressed companies to interviewing operators of great businesses that the founders wanted to invest in for the long term.
